aircraft_registration: UK civil aircraft registration: G- followed by four letters, like `G-ABCD` or `G-EZAB`.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a UK bank: four letters, GB and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `NWBKGB2L` or `BARCGB22XXX`.
company_name: UK company name: up to six capitalized words followed by Ltd, Limited, PLC, LLP or CIC in any case, with an optional dot, like `Acme Widgets Ltd.` or `Example Holdings PLC`.
company_number: UK company number (Companies House registration number, CRN) after company no, registered in England and Wales No. or CRN, keyword included: 6 to 8 digits, or SC, NI or OC and 6 digits.
driving_licence_number: UK driving licence number (DVLA driver number): 16 characters from the surname, date of birth and initials, like `MORGA657054SM9IJ` or grouped as `MORGA 657054 SM 9IJ`.
iban: UK IBAN: GB, two check digits, a four-letter bank code and 14 digits (sort code and account number), with or without spaces, like `GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 19`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a UK SIM: 8944 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `89441000000000000018`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a UK network: mobile country code 234 or 235 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `234150123456789`.
license_plate: UK number plate (vehicle registration number): the current `BD51 SMR` with real area letters, and the older prefix `P123 ABC` and suffix `ABC 123D` styles, with or without the space.
mobile_number: UK mobile number: 07 and nine more digits, national or with +44, 0044 or +44 (0), with spaces or dashes, like `07400 123456`; only valid UK, Channel Islands and Isle of Man mobiles.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a British passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, GBR or another British code (GBN, GBD, ...) as nationality, birth date, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: UK mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 44 and the number without its 0, 12 digits like `447400123456`; only valid UK, Channel Islands and Isle of Man mobiles.
national_insurance_number: UK National Insurance number (NINO, NI number): two prefix letters as HMRC issues them, six digits and a suffix A to D, with or without spaces, like `AB 12 34 56 C`.
nhs_number: NHS number after NHS, NHS No or NHS Number, keyword included in the match: ten digits, together or grouped 3-3-4 with spaces or dashes, like `NHS Number: 999 000 0018`.
passport_number: UK passport number after passport, passport no or passport number, keyword included in the match: nine digits, like `Passport No: 123456789`.
phone_number: UK phone number with a ten-digit national number: 0, +44, 0044 or +44 (0), or the area code in brackets like `(01234) 567890`, with spaces or dashes; only valid UK numbers.
postal_code: UK postcode with a real postcode area (Channel Islands and Isle of Man included), with or without the space, like `SW1A 1AA`, `M1 1AE` or `EC1A1BB`.
premium_number: UK premium-rate number: 090, 091 or 098 and eight more digits, national or with +44, like `0909 879 0123`; only valid UK numbers.
sort_code: UK bank sort code after sort code or s/c, keyword included, with the 8-digit account number when it follows; without a keyword only when written `60-16-13 31926819`.
street_address: UK street address, number first: house number and street with a common type (Street, St, Road, Lane, Avenue, Drive, Close, ...), with Flat or Unit before it, like `221B Baker Street`.
utr: UK Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) after UTR, Unique Taxpayer Reference or tax reference, keyword included: ten digits, together or split 5-5, like `UTR 22345 67890`.
vat_number: UK VAT registration number after GB, XI (Northern Ireland) or VAT No, which is part of the match: nine digits like `GB999 9999 73`, twelve with a branch, or government `GBGD001` and health `GBHA500`.
